title: The Thrower's Primer
summary: Teaches an untrained beginner to grip, balance and hurl a light spear at a still mark.

title: A Handbook of the Standing Throw
summary: Shows how a thrower standing square turns the hip and shoulder to send the shaft far and true.

title: Javelin Drill-Book for the Young Hand
summary: Sets short daily drills for grip, arm swing and release so a young thrower builds habit before strength.

title: The Run-Up and Release: A Workbook
summary: A workbook on the approach run and the release that teaches a thrower to carry speed into the shaft.

title: Short Treatise on the Light Spear's Flight
summary: Explains how a thrown shaft rises and falls and how spin and release angle decide where it lands.

title: Skirmisher's Bundle: Carrying and Casting
summary: Shows a skirmisher how to carry several javelins at once and throw them one after another.

title: The Strap-and-Shaft Handbook
summary: A handbook on the looped cord fixed to the shaft that lengthens the throw and spins the point.

title: Plain Rules for Throwing at a Moving Mark
summary: Gives plain rules for hitting a runner or a rider by throwing ahead of them and timing the release.

title: The Javelin Canon of First Principles
summary: Sets out grip, balance, line and release in plain order so any student can learn the javelin.

title: Hunter's Counsel on the Thrown Shaft
summary: Counsels a hunter on stalking close and throwing at beasts so the shaft kills cleanly.
